card.name: Final zero in thousands before units
card.fires_on: The last digit 0 of a comma-grouped number such as 10,000 or 1,500 when the next word is a unit (units, international units, U/L). It is mostly in dose amounts for hyaluronidase or hCG.

modes.label: Hyaluronidase unit counts
modes.description: Final 0 of a number like 10,000 or 30,000 followed by units hyaluronidase in combined subcutaneous products.
